verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-services API for notarization, incorporation, translation, and tax and trade registration, triggered by request endpoints and webhooks. It is not an automation-building platform where users author workflows that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Its 'automate notarization workflows' language means customers call its API from their own systems, and no evidence shows a workflow builder, so the versioning and rollback axis does not apply to this product type.
